mechanism: Tranylcypromine is an MAOI with inherent serotonergic activity, and topiramate may have weak serotonergic properties; combined CNS depression and potential for hypertensive crisis or serotonin syndrome exists.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use with caution, monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia) and blood pressure elevation, and consider alternative anticonvulsants.
